records.title: Measuring the Checker: Mutation Analysis for GPU-Kernel Benchmark Oracles
records.reason: Mutation analysis evaluates correctness-checker adequacy for GPU kernels, not LLM runtime efficiency.

records.title: Do LLMs Choose Like Humans? Using Cognitive Theory to Evaluate LLM Decision-Making
records.reason: The study evaluates LLM choice behavior against cognitive theory; no inference-efficiency method is proposed.

records.title: Explainable and domain-adaptive prediction models for refrigerant charging in air conditioning systems within industrial processes
records.reason: AC-RPX predicts refrigerant deficiency using an adapted LLM for explanations; its contribution is domain adaptation/accuracy, not serving efficiency.

records.title: Hierarchical multi-label structuring of Japanese SOAP clinical notes with large language models
records.reason: The paper structures Japanese clinical SOAP notes with a locally deployed QLoRA LLM and reports extraction quality; no inference optimization is stated.

records.title: Generative large language models in medicine: a scoping review of recent methodological advances
records.reason: This is a medical-methods scoping review spanning pretraining/fine-tuning/prompting; it does not report a specific inference-efficiency study.
